bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · lost $208, testing the 200-day
bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · 跌破 $208，测试 200 日均线

read.en: Nvidia fell 4.2% on Oct 30 to $204.64 (range $200.92–209.05) on 1.7 times average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($213.52), 10-day ($214.63) and 30-day ($223.66) and the rising 100-day ($214.52), and just above the rising 200-day ($204.38). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($221.24), and RSI is 35.
read.zh: 英伟达 10月30日下跌 4.2%，收于 $204.64（区间 $200.92–209.05），成交量为均量的 1.7 倍。股价低于下行的 5 日（$213.52）、10 日（$214.63）和 30 日均线（$223.66）以及上行的 100 日均线（$214.52），略高于上行的 200 日均线（$204.38）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$221.24），RSI 为 35。

read.en: The drop broke all three written supports, $214.5, $210.2–211.3 and $207.3–208.9, now resistance, but the close held the 200-day. Resistance is $207.3–209.1 (Aug 24 and Sep 14 lows, Oct 30 high), then $213.5–214.6 (5, 10 and 100-day) and $221.2 (SAR). Support is $200.9–204.4 (200-day, Oct 30 low), then $198–199.3 (Jul 17 and Jun 9 lows) and $190. A close above $209 would target $214; below $200.9, $198.

r.en: Aug 24 low $207.25; Sep 14 low $208.9; Oct 30 high $209.05
